hash_convention: sha256_lf = SHA-256 of the committed blob bytes (LF). The worktree is CRLF for some files (core.autocrlf=true), so sha256_worktree_raw differs for those; pins.check_pin normalises CRLF to LF.
manifest_rule: SHA-256 of the text 'path<TAB>sha256_lf<LF>' for every file in `files`, sorted by path
